findings.title: Delete and Pause menu items never render when `rulerRule` is omitted
findings.body: In the alert list view, `GrafanaRuleListItem` renders `RuleActionsButtons` with only `promRule` and leaves `rulerRule` undefined. Although `AlertRuleMenu` now computes `canDelete` and `canPause` using `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(promRule, ...)`, rendering of the Delete menu item on line 165 is still gated on `{canDelete && rulerRule && (` and rendering of `MenuItemPauseRule` on line 123 is still gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. Because `rulerRule` is undefined, neither the Delete nor the Pause menu item can ever appear for Grafana rules in the list view (and if `canPause` is the only truthy item in the first section alongside `canExport`, `showDivider` on line 119 will also render a leading divider at the top of the menu).

findings.title: Silence notifications action in the list view does not open the silence drawer
findings.body: When `RuleActionsButtons` is rendered from `GrafanaRuleListItem`, only `promRule` is provided and `rule` (`RulerRuleDTO`) is `undefined`. `AlertRuleMenu` enables the "Silence notifications" menu item via `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, and clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer` to `true`. However, line 104 still guards `<SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer>` with `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`. Because `rule` is `undefined`, `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` evaluates to `false`, so clicking "Silence notifications" in the rule list view does nothing.

findings.title: `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(skipToken)` reports `Duplicate` as supported and allowed for non-Grafana rules
findings.body: When `skipToken` is passed to `useGrafanaPromRuleAbility` or `useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` (which `AlertRuleMenu` and `RuleActionsButtons` do for any non-Grafana / data source rule), `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities(undefined)` is called. For `rule = undefined`, `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable(undefined)` returns `loading: false`, so line 309 sets `MaybeSupported = AlwaysSupported` (`true`) and line 313 sets `duplicateSupported = true`. Line 318 then computes `[AlertRuleAction.Duplicate]: toAbility(true, getRulesPermissions('grafana').create)`. Because `AlertRuleMenu` ORs `rulerDuplicateAbility` with `grafanaDuplicateAbility`, any user with permission to create Grafana rules (`AlertingRuleCreate`) will have `canDuplicate = true` on all data source rules—even if the data source has no Ruler API, the rule is plugin-provided, or the user lacks `AlertingRuleExternalWrite`. When `rule` is `undefined`, `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` should return `[NotSupported, false]` for all actions.

findings.title: Grafana recording rules lose `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` abilities
findings.body: In `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` (line 246), `isGrafanaManagedAlertRule` is computed with `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`, which is `true` for both Grafana alerting and recording rules. In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` (line 302), `isAlertingRule = prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is used instead and applied to `ModifyExport`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` (lines 324-330). For a `GrafanaPromRecordingRuleDTO`, `isAlertingRule` is `false`, so Grafana-managed recording rules in the rule list view cannot be exported with modifications, paused, restored, or permanently deleted. Only `AlertRuleAction.Silence` should require `prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)`, while the other actions should check `prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule)`.

findings.title: Missing `key` prop on `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` in `FilterViewResults`
findings.body: When replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader key={key} ... />` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem ... />` inside `rules.map(...)`, the `key={key}` prop was dropped. This triggers React's missing `key` warning for every Grafana rule rendered in the filter view and prevents React from properly reconciling list items across updates.

findings.title: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` no longer marks federated rule groups as immutable
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` previously checked `const isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` so that `Update`, `Delete`, `Pause`, `Restore`, and `DeletePermanently` were marked `NotSupported` for federated rule groups. Refactoring `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` to delegate to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)` replaces that check with `const isFederated = false` (line 245), allowing edit/delete abilities to report as supported on federated rule groups.
